profile.headline: Autonomous Software Engineer at Metal Shark
profile.summary: Software developer experienced with Linux, C++, Devops, and more.

positions.title: Senior Autonomous Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as an assistant lead and subject matter expert on autonomous maritime C++ software written in a Linux environment, specializing in collision avoidance and path planning. 
 
Also served as a subject matter expert on Devops topics such as Docker, Kubernetes, Ansible, and more.

positions.title: Autonomous Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed autonomous maritime C++ software within a Linux environment.
- Small scale sprint lead for environmental navigation focused path planning
- Interfaced with ROS2 architecture to implement multi-vessel collaborative maneuvers
- Designed pipeline to allow for the autonomous deployment and retrieval of payloads
 
Managed entire Devops CI/CD infrastructure.
- Troubleshooted issues that arose within the Gitlab, Artifactory, Jenkins, and Kubernetes instances
- Designed a Kubernetes-based solution for light-weight deployment of micro-services
- Added a new Docker image deployment feature to the Jenkins instance written in Python/Bash

positions.title: Junior Autonomous Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed autonomous maritime C++ software using the Qt Framework in a Linux environment.
- Designed and implemented a multi-vessel autonomous fleet solution
- Develop an emergency survival pipeline that triggers under dire situations to prioritize vessel safety
- Implemented the dynamic altering of mission structures based on external conditions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software for the CAPE-3 pico-satellite as well as the CloudSat-8 weather balloon.
 
CAPE-3 Website
- Utilized Angular to create secure website login, registration, and data display pages 
- Built C# .NET endpoints to connect to the satellite's SQL database, populating the pages
- Implemented protection of pages using user authentication and Angular’s route guards

CAPE-3 Firmware
- Utilized various libraries to implement a command parser in payload
- Discovered solutions to various bugs in the payload's C program

CloudSat-8 Weather Balloon C# .NET GUI
- Designed and developed a WPF application to allow users to communicate with the balloon
- Created infrastructure to parse and display data from the balloon's radio stream
- Implemented a feature to display the balloon’s coordinates to a map, allowing it to be live tracked

CloudSat-8 Weather Balloon Arduino Firmware
- Programmed temperature, pressure, and humidity sensors on the payload
- Designed balloon’s cut down pipeline, including altitude and time checks
- Implemented auto-tweeting and emailing feature
positions.insights: HTML, Angular Command Line Interface (CLI) and +10 skills

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Taught new CAPE members through weekly lectures on basic programming 
- Led students in their first weather balloon project

- Tutored lower level students on classes in the computer science curriculum
- Provided guidance for students struggling with assigned projects

projects.title: Qt Notepad
projects.description: This simple Qt C++ application is a small text editor that accounts for creating, saving, opening, and printing new text files.

projects.title: CAPE 3 Website
projects.description:
A website that displays certain CAPE-3 Satellite data depending on the user’s account permissions.

- Created endpoints in a .NET API to connect to the satellite’s SQL database and serve the frontend application
- Utilized Angular to create functional website login, registration, and data display pages 
- Implemented protection of pages using Angular’s route guards

organizations.name: CAPE
organizations.description:
- Developed software to successfully launch pico-satellites and weather balloons
- Combined software with electrical and mechanical engineering teams
- Taught and led new recruits in their own weather balloon project

organizations.name: ACM
organizations.description:
- Attended tech talks, resume workshops, and coding challenges
- Networked with colleagues in the Computer Science department
